# fjordrun_environment (Data Source)

An environment of a project, by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_environment" "staging" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  name       = "staging"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project ID.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Environment ID. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Environment name. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `is_ephemeral` (Boolean) Whether it is a short-lived preview environment.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name.
